lucy (People Ops): Manager heads-up: a couple small clarifications before submissions close. :bell:

lucy (People Ops): Deadlines recap: peer feedback due 2026-03-31; manager reviews due 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT; calibration week 2026-04-13 -> 2026-04-17; final lock 2026-04-24.

omar (Eng Manager): Quick Q  my peer feedback queue shows one reviewer who left the company last week. How should I record that?

rita (People Ops): Mark it in the peer form as "No feedback - left org" and add one line of context in the manager notes. We won't treat it as missing feedback for calibration.

devon (IC): If I submit peer feedback now, can I add a demo link later?

lucy (People Ops): Yes 1 peers can append a link within 48h of submission. Managers can also attach evidence in their review form.

omar (Eng Manager): And extension process for a 48h manager-level delay?

rita (People Ops): Submit the extension form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/extension-request and cc your director. We typically approve up to 48h for documented PTO/medical. Longer requests require escalation.

hr-bot: Reminder queued: "Manager reviews due in 7 days" will DM managers on 2026-04-03 09:00 PDT.

lucy (People Ops): Final checklist: paste the 3-line calibration snippet into the notes field, attach at least one artifact link, and RSVP to your calibration invite. Ping this thread if anything breaks. :white_check_mark:

omar (Eng Manager): Acknowledged 1 I'll tidy evidence and submit on time.
